name: Totals over taker
description: Taker: buys YES (over) at the proven ask, 20-80c, within 6 h of the first trade of an NBA/MLB totals market, one per market, held to settlement.
hypothesis: Over is underpriced on NBA/MLB totals: fixed-time screen +7.5c / +6.5c gross (se ~4c, both halves positive). Wrong if the walk-forward CI <= 0. Sample-limited: 150 markets per series, no lockbox data.
